reason: The source PR adds a lower bound on route insertion cost and skips heuristic insertion scans when that bound cannot beat the current best candidate. This is solver-level pruning in VROOM's route-building heuristic.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Safe insertion-cost bounds can reduce full route scans, allowing more heuristic work per fixed budget while preserving the best insertion decision.
causal_chain: Cached minimum inbound and outbound edges minus a maximum existing route edge form a lower bound on insertion delta; when it cannot beat the incumbent insertion score, the algorithm bypasses detailed position evaluation.
structural_trigger: CVRP route construction with unassigned single jobs and a nonempty candidate route whose insertion positions would otherwise be scanned.
activation_probe: Count lower-bound checks and skipped insertion loops in separate validation builds on the fixed public CVRP panel.
instance_selection_rule: Use VROOM's fixed public CVRP development and hidden ID panels with declared 1, 5, and 10-second budgets before inspecting this PR's hidden effect.
workload_exposure_plan: Run pinned base and source-only PR builds through the common VROOM CVRP driver and retain route quality, runtime, and pruning counters.
mathematical_risk: If the purported lower bound exceeds the true insertion delta, a valid better insertion may be pruned; output-route feasibility alone cannot establish bound validity.
independent_check_plan: Enumerate all insertion positions on small directed cost matrices and assert the new bound never exceeds the exact minimum insertion cost; independently verify every reported CVRP route and objective.
hidden_generalization_plan: Report paired hidden CVRP quality and runtime by instance size, preserving failures and regressions under identical budgets.
overlap_review: Review adjacent heuristic-bound PRs for shared code or dependent patches before creating another task from this pruning mechanism.
resource_risk: Per-route cached arrays scale with the number of jobs and may increase memory or hurt small instances where pruning is rare.
